text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ocean, clear blue skies—it's time for
summer camp! This is the perfect
opportunity to get in some good training,
so I'm feeling extra
pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The weather is so nice... Perfect for an
afternoon nap on the beach.
But before
that, I have one more lap to run, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bright is back to her usual self, but she
seems to be enjoying the
summer camp, so
our training is going well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
I shall leave the timing to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she comes back,
I let her rest while I
plan out our summer camp training regimen.
Up next is strength training in the
ocean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And after that is...
...ner? ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've been back for a while. Is something
the matter? You seem like
you're drifting
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...That reminds me. Trainer, you stayed up
late last night preparing
energy drinks for
our training, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Riiight?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then that settles it. Trainer, won't you
accompany me to tonight's
festival?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
One of the employees at the summer
dormitory spoke of it. They said
there
would be a festival close by this evening.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It seems many other Umamusume are
headed there. So I was thinking
we could
take it easy today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to finish up my work if I want to
enjoy this festival tonight!
First, I have to
figure out this training regimen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, you're organizing those documents
even faster than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a swift departure.
Breaks are fine
with me, but I do hope
Trainer is resting
properly as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Right. I must do my part as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun is already setting by the time I
finish up the training regimen. I've even
managed to map out a route for
tomorrow's run through the
forest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back. Come along, I've saved
a seat for you right next
to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I tell Bright about all the work I
still
have to do, she simply
looks at me and
smiles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now, now... You just made it back, did you
not? I've plenty of things
I'd like to talk
about with you today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
During our break, I went looking for
seashells on the shore with
Dober. And
guess what? There was a purple sea slug...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Out in the ocean, I saw jellyfish floating
dreamily about. I only
watched from the
shore, but the sight was truly enchanting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly feel today's fatigue hit me
all at
once, and Bright's
soothing voice feels
almost like a lullaby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can't fall asleep yet.
I still have so
many documents to go
through...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I even saw a big cloud, bigger than a
mountain. It looked so soft and
fluffy, like
freshly whipped ice cream slowly melting
away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, are you feeling sleepy? Go
ahead, gently slip away into the
land of
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Someone's Humming
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, hm-hm-hm, hm-hm-hmmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my dreams, I hear a gentle voice
soothing my soul with a familiar
lullaby.

text_block_list.name: Someone's Humming
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmmm... Hm-hm-hm,
hm-hm-hmmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, you've woken up already? You can
rest for longer, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I jump to my feet. When did I fall asleep
on this couch in the lobby?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I still need to submit those
documents, and there's that
festival I
promised to go to. Suddenly, Bright
speaks up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Those documents... They're meant for the
staff here, right? I took the
time to ask if
you could submit them tomorrow, and they
said it was okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As for the festival, we've no hurry to go,
have we? After all, we still
have next year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps,
I went too far? I only ended up
derailing your original
plans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've done nothing that deserves your
gratitude. I only acted as I
normally would,
taking things nice and slowly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I might've been overworking myself
recently... Thanks to Bright lulling
me to
sleep, I feel my energy coming back to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she hadn't helped me relax, then I
probably would've ended up too
tired to
even go to the festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Our usual pace... Yours, and mine, you
mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Mhm. In the end...
staying true to
my laid-back self is how I
should be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, look over there, Trainer. That carrot
stir-fry stall is still open.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time we arrive at the festival,
things
have mostly quieted
down, with many
people gradually making their way home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Many of the stalls have already closed up,
but you know what they
say, "Leftovers are
a sign of good things to come."

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, young miss! Wanna try your luck in the
raffle? There's only one try
left, and I'm
lookin' to sell out, y'see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, and speaking of good leftovers...
Teehee, I think I'll give this a
try.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you're a winner! Here's
your prize—a pretty brooch
for the pretty
lady!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Teehee, thank you very much. I'm
quite fond of this floral
design.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Trainer? You were right...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Every flower has its spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, we continue enjoying the
remainder of the festival. We walk along
slowly, leisurely, and at our own pace—a
pace fit for the
two of us.
